notes: Portable Update Rate table positivity preflight through official Federation Create and update-rate lookup services. The adapter supplies provider package, standard MIM, two schema-valid otherwise-matched FOM bindings, endpoint, logical time, and callback model. Zero is rejected with InconsistentFOM while 30.0 is accepted and publicly queryable. Non-finite or omitted rates, private diagnostics, Java provider runtime, and interoperability are not claimed. The existing generic invalid-FOM corpus includes zero but permits multiple failure types and does not isolate this rule.
